rivals.reason: The 2018 Camaro SS features a powerful 6.2L V8 engine, delivering a distinctly throaty exhaust note that makes it a formidable rival to the Mustang GT.
With its iconic HEMI V8 engine, the 2018 Challenger R/T offers a deep, rumbling cold-start sound that appeals to muscle car enthusiasts, making it a direct competitor of the Mustang.
While not a V8, the 2018 BRZ's naturally aspirated flat-four engine provides a unique exhaust note and exceptional handling, attracting those who appreciate a sportier, more agile alternative.
The 2018 Nissan 370Z, with its potent V6 engine and distinctive raw exhaust growl, stands shoulder to shoulder with the Mustang in terms of performance and driving fun.
